labels_directory: D:\research papper\rs\data\Multi-Weather Pothole Detection (MWPD)\Multi-Weather Pothole Detection (MWPD)\MWPD\test\labels
label_source: Canonical MWPD test labels matched by image filename stem
metric_method: Custom single-class, greedy one-to-one IoU matching. Pooled precision/recall/F1 are computed per condition. AP is calculated by globally confidence-ranking predictions within each condition.
latency_caveat: The adaptive latency column is an estimated selected-path latency: nano inference time plus medium inference time only when nano confidence is below threshold. Both models are executed for every image in this evaluation to obtain the fixed-model baselines. Therefore, this is NOT a direct wall-clock measurement of a deployed adaptive pipeline.
important_limitations: These are custom metrics and may differ from official Ultralytics validation metrics.
Condition images share canonical labels matched by filename stem.
The evaluation does not establish statistical significance.
The script evaluates detection quality and estimated path latency, not energy consumption.
